statement: The United States federal government enters a lapse in appropriations, a shutdown, beginning October 1, 2026, because Congress has not enacted full-year fiscal year 2027 appropriations or a continuing resolution before the September 30, 2026 funding deadline.
resolution: TRUE if the Office of Management and Budget issues lapse-in-appropriations guidance and federal agencies begin furlough operations on or after October 1, 2026, as reported by at least two of AP, Reuters, or a wire service. FALSE if a continuing resolution or appropriations act is signed into law before the deadline and funding continues without interruption.
failure_condition: No lapse in appropriations occurs; federal funding continues without interruption past October 1, 2026 via a signed continuing resolution or appropriations act.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Ed Markey defeats Seth Moulton in the Massachusetts Democratic primary for United States Senate held September 1, 2026.
resolution: TRUE if Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth results, as reported by AP or a Massachusetts wire service, show Ed Markey receiving more votes than Seth Moulton in the September 1, 2026 Democratic Senate primary. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: Seth Moulton receives more votes than Ed Markey in the September 1, 2026 Massachusetts Democratic Senate primary, or the race remains uncalled for Markey by the deadline.
